title: Public speaks on US 183 West annexation
summary:
*   The meeting was primarily dedicated to a public hearing concerning the proposed annexation of the U.S. 183 West area.
*   City officials presented comprehensive information regarding the annexation issues and plans for providing services to the area.
*   A substantial number of citizens, 179, actively participated by signing up to share their views during the hearing.
*   After lengthy public input and presentations, the public hearing on the annexation was officially closed.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
OCTOBER 27,1997-7:00 P.M.
Mayor Watson called the meeting to order, noting the absence of Councilmembers Griffith
and Slusher.
Councilmember Slusher came at 10:34 p.m.
Public Hearing on annexation of U.S. 183 West Assistant City Manager Toby Futrell
presented areas of information on the annexation issues and where these could be located.
Several department directors and assistant directors presented the different areas of the
service plan.
179 Citizens signed appearance cards (on file in City Clerk's Office) Close the public
hearing on Councilmember Slusher's motion, Councilmember Spelman's second, 6-0 vote,
Councilmember Griffith absent.
ADJOURNED at 11:47 p.m. on Councilmember Slusher's motion, Councilmember Spelman's second,
6-0 vote, Councilmember Griffith absent.
Approved on this the 20th day of November, 1997 on, Councilmember Spelman's motion,
Councilmember Lewis' second, 7-0 with Mayor Pro Tern Garcia abstaining on Special Called
meeting of November 12,1997.
